$Comment: Martha's graveyard daily: beat the Great Turkey once a day, either way in. The _Harvest_Feast folder
makes the id harvest_feast_daily_graveyard, so the Almanac's Errands tally and Helping Hands count it
with Martha's other dailies (the harvest_feast_daily_ prefix). Requires opens it once a player has
finished The Great Turkey (harvest_feast_great_turkey) and collected its pay, so it follows a first win.
Martha offers it on her graveyard_daily_offer screen; while it is carried her conversation opens on her
graveyard screen, with both ways in, and its hand-in shares her ready_generic screen with the other
ENCOUNTER_DEFEATED with MatchMode PREFIX on the normal fight's script id counts its hard twin
(Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Encounter_Hard) too; MatchMode EXACT would hold it to the normal way in.
Every player the fight credits counts the win, but only those carrying this quest when it falls.
Npc.TurnInId, from the base, adds the report-back step to Martha.
Repeat.Reset with Period Daily is a calendar daily: it comes back at midnight UTC, not a fixed number
of hours after the last one. It pays through Harvest_Feast_Daily_Pay like the other dailies, so
retuning that pay is one edit there; the favor rows are this file's own, a little more than the other
dailies' since each run costs a Wishbone.
The Mmo_Xp row is MMO Skill Tree's: Defense XP for the fight, paid only where that mod runs. Its own
Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves the row out on a server without it, unpaid and
unshown, and the rest of the quest pays.
Name: Daily_Graveyard
